items.title: fix(ui): keep automation model provider choices distinct (#164574)
items.summary: fix(ui): keep automation model provider choices distinct (#164574) Fixes #164572. The Automations model picker lost provider metadata when discovered models from different providers shared a raw model ID, so it showed a single bare entry and saved jobs resolved to the wrong provider. The catalog publication boundary now keeps provider-qualified ids through the existing qualified-model helper. Configured suggestions, aliases and custom qualified input are unchanged, and already-saved bare overrides are not migrated. Proof: in real Chromium against a built Gateway with two providers that both list `shared-model`, base collapsed them into one `shared-model` entry and saved a bare override. With this change the picker shows `alpha/shared-model` and `beta/shared-model`, and choosing beta saved `beta/shared-model`, verified via the cron list. Before and after screenshots are in the PR. The regression tests fail on base and pass here. A live gpt-5-mini smoke call passed. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: refactor(core): deslop small core subsystems (#164708)
items.summary: refactor(core): deslop small core subsystems (#164708) Reduce duplicated credential selection, one-use forwarding layers, temporary representations, and fixed-option plumbing across core subsystems. Preserve configuration, persisted data, protocol shapes, visible output, SDK contracts, security checks, and lifecycle fencing. Net production reduction: 1,000 lines. Independent review resolved all accepted findings. Remote focused tests, changed checks, both import-cycle checks, and 133,360 baseline/candidate regex comparisons passed. Final main integration passed 119 focused cases plus 105 skill provenance cases. Exact-head CI run 37176303676 passed 75 jobs. Land under the maintainer-authorized inherited-main exception: ACPX runtime-owner.process.test.ts has the same stale shared-project canonical-key expectation as run 37171670932; the Windows write-unified-entry-dts fixture has the same ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND as run 37175940598. All security reviews and seven CodeQL security jobs passed, with zero open PR code-scanning alerts. Full attribution and evidence are in the PR.
